name: System
description: Contains information about the computer system.
remarks: Use the System property to return the System object. If the operating system is Windows, the following example makes a network connection to \\Project\Info. The following example displays the current screen resolution (for example, "1024 x 768").

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified System object.

properties.name: OperatingSystem
properties.description: Returns the name of the current operating system (for example, "Windows" or "Windows Server"). Read-only String.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Returns the version number of the operating system. Read-only String.

properties.name: FreeDiskSpace
properties.description: Returns the available disk space for the current drive, in bytes. Use the ChDrive statement to change the current drive. Read-only Long.

properties.name: LanguageDesignation
properties.description: Returns the designated language of the system software. Read-only String.

properties.name: HorizontalResolution
properties.description: Returns the horizontal display resolution, in pixels. Read-only Long.

properties.name: VerticalResolution
properties.description: Returns the vertical screen resolution in pixels. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ProfileString
properties.description: Returns or sets a value for an entry in the Windows registry under the following subkey: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Office\version\Word. Read/write String.

properties.name: PrivateProfileString
properties.description: Returns or sets a string in a settings file or the Microsoft Windows registry. Read/write String.

properties.name: MathCoprocessorInstalled
properties.description: True if a math coprocessor is installed on the system. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Cursor
properties.description: Returns or sets the state (shape) of the pointer. Can be one of the following WdCursorType constants: wdCursorIBeam, wdCursorNormal, wdCursorNorthwestArrow, or wdCursorWait. Read/write Long.

properties.name: CountryRegion
properties.description: Returns the country/region designation of the system. Read-only WdCountry.

methods.name: MSInfo
methods.description: Starts the Microsoft System Information application if it is not running, or switches to it if it is already running.

methods.name: Connect
methods.signature: Connect(Path As String, [Drive As Variant], [Password As Variant])
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a network drive.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path for the network drive (for example, "\\Project\Info").

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: A number corresponding to the letter you want to assign to the network drive, where 0 (zero) corresponds to the first available drive letter, 1 corresponds to the second available drive letter, and so on. If this argument is omitted, the next available letter is used.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password, if the network drive is protected with a password.
